name: codex-streamctl
description: Coding-agent skill for durable append-only coordination streams.

interface.shortDescription: Share durable append-only streams between coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Codex Streamctl provides guidance for creating shared streams, appending immutable entries, reading from stable positions, and advancing per-reader acknowledgements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-streamctl for a durable shared exchange between coding agents.
